prompt.project_info: Create a candid photorealistic 2000s digital-camera mirror selfie in a cluttered bathroom.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with messy textured reddish-brown hair, pale natural skin with pores and freckles, winged eyeliner, and direct eye contact, wearing a simple dark heather-grey V-neck T-shirt and casually holding a finger near her mouth without suggestive intent.
prompt.composition_elements: Eye-level mirror selfie close to the mirror, one arm raised naturally, dirty mirror with water spots, smudges and dust, beige floral wallpaper, towel rack, shower curtain rod, and ceiling light fixture in the reflection; line-art floral, script, and small heart tattoos remain optional reference details.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Harsh direct camera flash produces mirror glare and hard shadows, with raw candid amateur photography, natural skin imperfections, and early-2000s digital-camera atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4K-style smartphone/digital-camera mirror selfie, eye-level angle, sharp skin and mirror-grime texture, direct flash, natural color and subtle digital noise.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: An approved adult woman with messy textured reddish-brown hair parted to the side, pale skin with visible pores, natural imperfections and freckles, winged eyeliner, and direct eye contact takes a candid mirror selfie. She wears a simple dark heather-grey V-neck T-shirt and raises one arm naturally near her mouth in a nervous or playful non-suggestive gesture. The cluttered bathroom has vintage beige floral wallpaper, a dirty mirror with water spots, smudges and dust, a towel rack, shower curtain rod, and ceiling light fixture visible in reflection. Use harsh direct camera flash with bright mirror glare and hard shadows, a raw 2000s digital-camera vibe, realistic skin and mirror-grime detail, eye-level framing, natural color, and subtle digital noise. Optional small line-art floral, script, and heart tattoos may be included only when supplied by the reference.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, lingerie, exposed chest, erotic gesture, sexualized expression, nudity, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required approved-adult reference. Keep the gesture casual and non-sexualized.
